findings.reason: the call-site contract would collapse from `(model, reasoning_effort)` to `(seat)`, removing a per-call-site argument the plan otherwise adds across every discovery LLM call.
findings.text: §21 adds `reasoning_effort=get_reasoning_effort(<seat>)` at every discovery call site as a parallel argument to the `model` those sites already pass, yet the same layer's per-seat resolution (`register_model_endpoints` + `_build_kwargs`, imas_codex/settings.py:313-379) exists precisely so "any caller ... can resolve a local endpoint without knowing which section a model came from"; the plan states the call-site threading but never states why that seam cannot instead take the seat and resolve both the model and its reasoning effort, leaving two identifiers per call site where one would do

thin_wrapper-1.reason: the endpoint registry is keyed by model id and six pyproject seats, including sn-compose, already share local/deepseek-v4.1-flash, so resolving reasoning effort from the id would give every seat on that model one effort and defeat the per-function split; the standard-names call sites already pass get_reasoning_effort(<seat>) per call, which §21 follows, and collapsing the LLM-layer contract to a seat argument would change every caller outside discovery

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; §21 extends the existing seat table and §14 reuses the existing discovery pipeline entry points, so no behaviour is hidden behind a new interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §21 extends the owner (`register_model_endpoints` binds a `model-route`-carrying seat to its endpoint, imas_codex/settings.py:327-338) rather than forking it, and §14 extends `seed_facility_roots` rather than seeding rows by hand.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §21 adds no CLI option, MCP view or refusal family and names in its own text what it retires ("The `language` and `vision` seats are retired (no compatibility alias)"), so its seat-count change is accounted for.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §21 cites and mirrors the existing `sn-*` seat family (`[tool.imas-codex.sn-compose]`/`sn-docs`/`sn-refine` in pyproject.toml and the `MODEL_SECTIONS`/`get_model`/`register_model_endpoints` machinery in imas_codex/settings.py:137,313), and §14 cites the existing `seed_facility_roots` (imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:426) and the landed `render_path_prefix_clause` (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268), both verified present and used by `--root` in imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:21,271.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §21 threads `reasoning_effort=get_reasoning_effort(<seat>)` from every discovery call site as a second per-call argument beside the model, and does not say why the LLM layer that already resolves per-seat config cannot own it.
